text:
mike: FYI customer Acme Retail hit us — mid-cycle downgrade + PO on file, attempted payment after invoice generated failed. amounts not matching the expected proration. can someone take? :grimacing:

sara: can you paste the invoice id + PO number and the payment attempt id? also which region (VAT) — EU or NA?

mike: invoice: inv_2026-ACM-7789, PO: PO-9988, payment attempt: pay_3ds_01H23, region: EU (Netherlands VAT). Customer downgraded from Pro ($120/mo) to Starter ($60/mo) on 2026-02-11, billing cycle 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28.

ops-bot: billing-job/charge_attempt failed for pay_3ds_01H23 -> status: 402 card_declined_authorize_3ds, retry_count: 0, logged_at: 2026-02-12T09:13:02Z

mike: here's the API error returned by the payments gateway when we tried fallback capture:```{\n  "error": {\n    "code": "card_declined_authorize_3ds",\n    "message": "3DS required for authentication",\n    "transaction_id": "pay_3ds_01H23"\n  }\n}```

julia: thanks. two things happening: 1) the card decline caused us to not capture the post-downgrade prorated delta; 2) the account already had PO-9988 associated so Finance expects a credit note applied (not a refund to card). Where the mismatch shows up is VAT rounding between invoice lines and the generated credit note.

sara: what's the expected credit amount by your calc?

julia: rough calc below — billing uses day-precision and rounds to cents per line.
```
original_plan = $120.00 (monthly)
new_plan = $60.00 (monthly)
cycle_days = 28
downgrade_day = 11 (customer used 10 full days)
remaining_days = cycle_days - downgrade_day + 1 = 18
prorated_refund_amount = (original_plan - new_plan) * (remaining_days / cycle_days)
 = $60 * (18/28) = $60 * 0.642857 = $38.57142 -> rounded = $38.57
VAT (21%) on refund line: 38.57 * 0.21 = 8.0997 -> tax rounded = $8.10
credit_note_total = 38.57 + 8.10 = $46.67
```

mike: the customer is seeing a credit note for $46.68 on their portal and our ledger shows $46.67 — customer noticed 1c mismatch and opened a support ticket. also stripe/gateway shows we attempted a small capture of full invoice and later issued a partial credit of $38.57 (no tax lines attached).

julia: root cause: our credit note generator has two code paths — one that preserves tax breakdown when creating a credit note against an invoice, another that issues a generic negative line item (no separate tax entry) when the payment failed and we generate the credit note from the subscription change webhook. The two paths handle rounding slightly differently.

nate: is this safe to reconcile manually? small amount but customer is small and wants clean ledger + PO applied. Any compliance impact for VAT in NL if we issue a one-cent adjustment?

julia: safe if we issue a correcting credit note that references the original invoice and includes explicit tax lines. For EU VAT we need to ensure the tax_amounts match across invoice and credit note. I'll generate a manual credit note referencing inv_2026-ACM-7789 and include the tax breakdown.

sara: steps for manual fix (BillingOps playbook):
1) Create credit note in accounting UI against inv_2026-ACM-7789.
2) Add one negative line: amount = $38.57, tax rate = 21%, tax = $8.10. Total = $46.67.
3) Apply credit note to customer's open balance and mark as applied to PO-9988.
4) Create internal journal entry to move 1 cent from rounding_reserve -> adjustments if needed.
5) Annotate with support ticket #TCK-4462 and record who approved.

mike: can you do that and cc me? i'll tell the customer this is being corrected and will reflect in 24h.

julia: will do. quick note on automation: we should patch the webhook path to produce tax lines even on failed payment-generated credit notes. I'll open a follow-up with eng.

ops-bot: ticket created -> BILL-1219 (BillingOps manual credit note for inv_2026-ACM-7789), assigned to julia, due 2026-02-13T16:00:00Z

mike: one more thing — customer asked for the PO to be applied to the corrected invoice/credit and for us to avoid attempting another card capture (they prefer PO billing). how do we ensure future attempts stop?

sara: set account.billing_method = "PO" and disable card auto-capture flag in account settings. I'll make the change after julia issues the credit note.

julia: credit note done: cn_2026-ACM-009, total $46.67. applied to balance and linked to PO-9988. journal entry: JE-5599 created for 0.01 rounding reserve adjustment. leaving note in ticket.

mike: thanks all — customer confirms portal now shows $0 outstanding and PO applied. closing the case. :tada:

nate: follow-up action: eng-billing to add unit-tests for rounding parity and add an alert when credit_note_total != expected_total by > $0.02. I'll coordinate with product.

sara: thanks — documenting outcome in the billing runbook and adding a KB entry for ops on EU VAT rounding for proration cases.

mike: closing thread.
